question_text: The moment of inertia of a uniform ring of mass M and radius R about an axis through its centre and perpendicular to its plane is:
explanation: All the mass of a ring is at distance R from the axis, so I = MR².
subject: Physics

question_text: The moment of inertia of a uniform solid sphere of mass M and radius R about a diameter is:
explanation: For a solid sphere, I = (2/5)MR² about any diameter.
subject: Physics

question_text: The moment of inertia of a thin uniform rod of mass M and length L about an axis through one end and perpendicular to the rod is:
explanation: I_cm = ML²/12. By the parallel axis theorem, I = ML²/12 + M(L/2)² = ML²/3.
subject: Physics

question_text: A torque of 20 N m acts on a body of moment of inertia 5 kg m². The angular acceleration is:
explanation: α = τ/I = 20/5 = 4 rad/s².
subject: Physics

question_text: A particle of mass 2 kg moves with speed 3 m/s along a straight line whose perpendicular distance from a point O is 4 m. Its angular momentum about O is:
explanation: L = mvr = 2 × 3 × 4 = 24 kg m²/s.
subject: Physics

question_text: A skater spinning with her arms outstretched pulls them in, so that her moment of inertia becomes half. Her angular speed becomes:
explanation: L = Iω is conserved, so halving I doubles ω.
subject: Physics

question_text: A disc of moment of inertia 2 kg m² rotates at 10 rad/s. Its rotational kinetic energy is:
subject: Physics

question_text: For a solid sphere rolling without slipping, the ratio of its rotational kinetic energy to its total kinetic energy is:
explanation: Translational KE = ½mv², rotational KE = ½(2/5 mR²)(v/R)² = mv²/5. Total = 7mv²/10, so the ratio is (1/5)/(7/10) = 2/7.
subject: Physics

question_text: A solid cylinder rolls without slipping down a 30° incline (g = 10 m/s²). Its acceleration is:
explanation: For a solid cylinder, a = (2/3)g sinθ = (2/3) × 10 × 0.5 = 10/3 m/s².
subject: Physics

subject: Physics

question_text: A 60 kg man walks 4 m along a 240 kg boat floating on still water, in a straight line. Neglecting water resistance, the boat moves backward through:
explanation: The centre of mass stays fixed. If the boat moves d, the man moves 4 − d relative to the ground, so 60(4 − d) = 240d, giving d = 0.8 m.
subject: Physics

question_text: The radius of gyration of a uniform solid disc of radius R about an axis through its centre and perpendicular to its plane is:
explanation: I = ½MR² = Mk², so k = R/√2.
subject: Physics

question_text: The moment of inertia of a uniform disc of mass M and radius R about a diameter is:
explanation: By the perpendicular axis theorem, 2I_diameter = ½MR², so I_diameter = MR²/4.
subject: Physics

question_text: The angular momentum of a body varies with time as L = 4t² (in kg m²/s, t in s). The torque acting on it at t = 2 s is:
explanation: τ = dL/dt = 8t = 16 N m at t = 2 s.
subject: Physics

question_text: A wheel of radius 0.5 m rolls without slipping on a horizontal road with its centre moving at 10 m/s. The speed of the topmost point relative to the ground is:
explanation: The top point has speed v + ωR = 2v = 20 m/s.
subject: Physics

question_text: A constant torque of 5 N m rotates a body through 4 rad. The work done by the torque is:
subject: Physics

question_text: A ring and a solid disc of the same mass and radius are released from rest at the top of an incline and roll without slipping. Which reaches the bottom first?
explanation: a = g sinθ/(1 + k²/R²). The disc has k²/R² = 1/2 and the ring has 1, so the disc has the larger acceleration.
subject: Physics

question_text: A 30 kg child sits 2 m from the pivot of a light seesaw. Where must a 20 kg child sit on the other side to balance it?
explanation: For balance, 30 × 2 = 20 × d, so d = 3 m.
subject: Physics

question_text: Two 1 kg point masses are fixed at the ends of a light rod of length 2 m. The moment of inertia about an axis through the centre and perpendicular to the rod is:
subject: Physics

question_text: A flywheel of moment of inertia 0.5 kg m² starts from rest under a constant torque of 2 N m. Its angular speed after 5 s is:
explanation: α = 2/0.5 = 4 rad/s², so ω = αt = 20 rad/s.
subject: Physics

question_text: Two equal and opposite parallel forces of 10 N each act at points 0.3 m apart. The torque of this couple is:
explanation: Torque of a couple = F × perpendicular separation = 10 × 0.3 = 3 N m.
subject: Physics

question_text: A rigid body rotates about a fixed axis with constant angular acceleration. Which statements are correct?

options.A: Particles farther from the axis have greater linear speed
options.B: All particles have the same angular acceleration
options.C: All particles have the same angular velocity at a given instant
options.D: All particles have the same linear velocity

explanation: In a rigid body every particle has the same ω and α, while the linear speed v = ωr grows with distance from the axis.
subject: Physics

question_text: A ring rolls without slipping on a horizontal surface. Which statements are correct?

options.A: The friction force does negative work on the ring
options.B: The point of contact is instantaneously at rest relative to the ground
options.C: The speed of the centre equals ωR
options.D: The speed of the topmost point is twice the speed of the centre

explanation: In pure rolling the contact point is at rest, v_cm = ωR and the top point moves at 2v_cm. Static friction at the contact point does no work.
subject: Physics

subject: Physics

question_text: A uniform solid disc of mass 4 kg and radius 0.5 m rotates about its axis. Its moment of inertia (in kg m²) is:
explanation: I = ½MR² = ½ × 4 × 0.25 = 0.5 kg m².
subject: Physics

question_text: A torque of 12 N m acts on a body of moment of inertia 3 kg m², starting from rest. Its angular speed (in rad/s) after 2 s is:
explanation: α = 12/3 = 4 rad/s², so ω = 4 × 2 = 8 rad/s.
subject: Physics

subject: Physics

question_text: A particle of mass 0.5 kg moves in a circle of radius 2 m with an angular speed of 3 rad/s. Its angular momentum about the centre (in kg m²/s) is:
explanation: L = mr²ω = 0.5 × 4 × 3 = 6 kg m²/s.
subject: Physics

question_text: A uniform disc of mass 4 kg and radius 1 m rotates about an axis through its edge and perpendicular to its plane. Its moment of inertia (in kg m²) is:
explanation: I = ½MR² + MR² = (3/2) × 4 × 1 = 6 kg m².
subject: Physics
